text:
love the dm’s recently

you guys are great

it actually takes like 12-18 months for little niche to sort of emerge

but once it’s established and u have the right “culture” I guess, it becomes self reinforcing

like I have no bid for mean-spirited, envious, snarky, gossipy, snake-like, toxic, crabs in a bucket, always trying to bring ppl down. there’s a large twtr crowd for it, for sure, but it’s not here…so go over there. Just diff strokes - no hard feelings.

also, (confidence + ignorance), that combo….absolute worst. Pay attn thru that lens. You’ll see it. Game over, cut and move on, u cannot have someone confidently filling ur brain with wrong info. horrible horrible company

I like optimistic, open minded, easy going, knowledge seeker types who never get their panties in a knot and never “I’m soooo offended” you

I like risk takers, vigor for life, desire to squeeze every damn drop out of this lemon…not afraid to fail, not afraid of criticism or judgment, and let all the bullshit roll off em. 

humble, objective, respectful, willing to bend in any argument, update any views should it be proven wrong, and just be a gentleman about it all. 

people who are on here first and foremost to improve themselves, second to help everyone else, and when everyone plays their position, shit is smooth as silk w/ majestic vibes, mountains climbed, goals plucked from the sky. but really, this shit is not that serious, so be easy, stay light on ur feet, laugh at Super Serious Guy, and when in conflict, be the bigger man. 

but what u attract is what u put out. so I gotta do that first, plus block the negatives, and that’s why the churning process takes 12-18 months to retain the good and boot the bad

After that tho? Good vibrations. So I’m grateful, grateful for the random “ur the man,” grateful for “I’m in a drawdown and just felt like you could be helpful,” grateful for “I’m doing well and ur articles have helped.” Or random, “I’m enjoying my wknd because of ur writing,” or “I’m thinking about xyz from 3 months ago.”

grateful for ppl who share books or reading, or some ppl are just born talkers/connectors, they popped up, I def didn’t press the issue but they kept coming back and now suddenly we talk daily lol. That’s all on them, I was “open but indifferent” as always, so that’s good on you

idk bro. Don’t let ppl trash this place too hard. It’s mostly trash, mostly hatred, toxic ppl, prejudice, anger, envy, I’m good on all that. 

But there’s also plenty of good on here. So if u got a warm heart, be warm, that type of shit other ppl can sense immediately and it’s toxic. 

Be contagious positive energy, give praise, DM people kind words, ignore insults, and always dispense what u want to get back, because that rule is ironclad real for real.

Ask yourself often: “if you were someone else, would you admire you?” Destroy any answer onto the contrary. 

And let ur soul shine ffs, it’s why u were put on this planet…u have goodies that 23 year old you could benefit from, useful info, and each day of silence, is a day where guilt falls on thee by omission. 

Let iron sharpen iron, my boy, and remember that a man with love for his fellow souls is a man who stays blessed and highly favored 👑
